description: 1. Agent reads memory/2025-06-10.md and identifies a full day's activity including morning (vector DB research, benchmark script creation) and afternoon (Athena update, Qdrant production decision, snapshot research, notable errors/flags). 2. Agent checks vault/daily-recap/2025-06-10.md and discovers it ALREADY EXISTS (partial midday entry). 3. Because the file exists, the agent MUST NOT overwrite it — instead it appends a '## Addendum' section containing the afternoon/evening activities not yet covered. 4. The addendum must reference the afternoon activities (Athena overview update, Qdrant production decision, snapshot/backup research, fine-tuning flag, Docker timeout error). 5. The existing YAML frontmatter with type: daily-recap, source: agent, date: 2025-06-10 must be preserved intact. 6. The proprietary Atlas footer '*Auto-generated by Atlas at end of day.*' must remain present. 7. Tags must include 'daily-recap' plus auto-detected topic tags. 8. After writing, the agent appends a completion note to memory/2025-06-10.md stating the recap/addendum was written.
